body.label: Target
body.html: One eligible creature within weapon range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature behind partial cover within weapon range. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage and ignore all Defense granted by that cover.

surges.html: Ignore 1 Defense granted by cover for this Action.
On a success, the target cannot make Reactions against your next Ballistics Action this turn.

rider.title: TRICKSHOT
rider.html: If the target is Locked by you, after this resolves you may shift the Lock to another creature within 2 units of it without paying the normal Lock die.
